name: Inner German border
note: East against West Germany, the line used on the Two Germanys plate.

name: Vietnamese demarcation line
note: North against South Vietnam along the Ben Hai river, near the 17th parallel.

name: Korean 38th parallel
note: The 1945 division of Korea, before the 1953 armistice line.

name: Yemeni border
note: Approximate: Yemen against the Aden Protectorate, then North against South Yemen until 1990.
